text:
Zoe: Quick sync 
We shipped the launch post + replay at 07:20. Want a focused microexperiment to compare three onboarding journeys for inbound launch traffic (credits, templates, checklist). KPI: first-success rate + conversion to second request within 48h. Target lift: +5pp in 10 days.

Miguel: Proposal: 3 arms randomized by signup_id
- Arm C1 (credits): 35 credits on signup + starter modal
- Arm C2 (templates): 0 credits + inline template tray + 24h drip
- Arm C3 (checklist): 0 credits + actionable checklist + 5-min demo clip nudge
Split 33/33/34. Per-user credit cap 35, global cap 6k.

Anya: Measurement: primary= pct_first_success_within_24h, secondary= median_time_to_second_request. Events: signup.source, credit_grant, prompt_clicked, generation.success, video_play, checklist_completed. I'll own SQL and dashboard.

Zoe: Routing note: inbound launch_post traffic should get tag `launch_path_2026_v2`. Can eng set rule: utm_campaign==starter_narrative -> onboarding_flow_experiment? (ping @eng-marketing)

Routing Bot: Routing PR opened #1012 -> onboarding_flow_experiment. Staging rule applied to dev cluster.

Miguel: Copy plan: short welcome + inline CTA. Subjects to test within arms later. I'll draft variants: concise friendly tone.

Design Bot: Modal comps added to Figma: /figma/launch/starter_onboard. Recommend inline tray for templates arm per mobile constraints.

Anya: QA checklist: cohort tag present, credit idempotency, sample 100 users per arm validated, dashboard events firing. I'll run smoke test at 11:45 PT and report.

Zoe: Timing: aim flip 09:00 PT tomorrow. Owners: Miguel (copy + cadence), Anya (measurement + QA), Design (assets), Eng (routing + quota enforcement). Leave rollback route that sends everyone to control onboarding_flow_v1.

Miguel: Noted. I'll also prepare a short onboarding email cadence: immediate welcome, 12h nudge, 3d checklist reminder.

Zoe: Budget note: keep total credits <= 6k; TTL 21d. If we hit 80% of cap, auto-failover to templates arm. Eng please implement guardrail.

Routing Bot: Failover rule queued (PR #1014).

Anya: Pre-launch smoke: cohort tags OK, credit grants idempotent, samples look clean. No blockers from data side.

Zoe: Great. Post results in-channel after 24h and weekly snapshots. Thanks all :rocket:
